humanlint.py.calibration_rule: ai-* must FLAG with index >= 50; human-* must be <= 15 — rerun after any threshold or wordlist change
humanlint.py.v0.1.1: added short_sentence_presence (zh ≤12字/300字, en ≤6 words/150 words), flat_run_max (consecutive sentences within ±8字/±5 words; ai-en = 8 → flag), same_opener_ratio; calibration re-run: ai 60/63 FLAG, human 2/0

factdiff.py.clean_paraphrase(human-en): pass (soft warn: sentence-initial 'Two' read as proper noun)
factdiff.py.tampered_numbers(human-zh): FAIL — DROPPED 5 万, ADDED 8 万 / 90 秒
factdiff.py.ai-zh vs human-zh: FAIL as expected (different documents; 14 numbers the AI draft never had) — demonstrates why humanize must mark [需核实] instead of inventing anchors

fix_list: run behaviorally: take 5 held-out AI drafts (not the fixtures), run /humanize with and without the skill loaded, send both outputs to an isolated cold-reader; certify only if with-skill pass rate beats no-skill beyond a 2-of-5 noise band
factdiff proper-noun layer is noisy (sentence-initial capitalized words); consider excluding words that also appear lowercase in the same text
humanlint TRIAD_EN regex is coarse (matches any 'A, B, and C'); acceptable as density signal, do not promote to reject
cold-reader verdict rules are declarative in agents/cold-reader.md — not compiled; a yaml schema check for cold-read.yaml would make round-cap enforcement mechanical
